summary: Feed s070_single is degraded: 8.3% of frames (183/2201) truncated to ~256 bytes, breaking NDR full-payload inspection. All other checks (duplicates, encrypted_share, missing_vlan, one_way, oversize, packet_drops, tool_overload, tunnel) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is slicing packets with snaplen ~256 bytes before delivery, likely to save bandwidth/tool capacity. Broker truncates L4 payload while NDR requires full payload.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for DPI, file extraction, and signature/behavioral detection. Truncated frames prevent session reassembly and cause missed detections and reduced coverage.

recommended_fix.why: NDR needs_full_payload=true and supports max_frame_bytes 9216. Disabling slicing/forwarding full frames restores complete payload to the tool.
